item.title: Yuusha ga Yadoya no Shujin kara Koibito o Netoru Hanashi.
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Getsumen-chuugaeri
  • 発売日: 2014-02-21
  • スコア: 5.46/10 (7 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 勇者が宿屋の主人から恋人を寝取る話。
  • 英語名: Yuusha ga Yadoya no Shujin kara Koibito o Netoru Hanashi.

别名

  • A Cuckold Story at the Adventurer’s Inn

あらすじ

The timeline begins five years after hordes of monsters which are called orcs in past documents had appeared and had begun to constantly terrorize the people.

They are plundering, killing and kidnapping young women for their reproduction as there are solely male orcs.
